spans.s: jhāṣayati (cf. Skt. Lex. jhaṣ-, jaṣ-, Pali Lex. jhas-, Childers; Vedic jasate, jāsayati), pulverizes, destroys utterly (so Tib. cited on Śikṣ 〔59.12〕, thal bar rlog): ˚ti Śikṣ 〔59.12〕 (pūrvāvaropitāni kuśalamūlāni), similarly 〔61.2〕, and ˚nti- 〔60.12〕; (svakleśāṃś ca parakleśāṃś ca) ˚ti 〔89.3〕.
